acceptanceCriteria: A failed scheduled release-gates run produces one deduplicated, visible signal naming the failing steps and run URL.
ci-least-privilege-check and actionlint pass; permissions are the minimum the signal needs.
body: Release-gates nightly runs 37628218263, 37784861599, 37935833612 and 38052349384 (2026-10-07..10) all failed on main and the failures went unticketed until a V1-0848 review on 2026-10-10 noticed them. A scheduled failure should produce a visible signal (for example an issue opened or updated with the failing step names and run URL) owned by someone. Must keep least-privilege (ci-least-privilege-check) and must not post or bypass ci-control-plane.
title: release-gates nightly: a failed nightly run on main gets no alert or triage owner
